title: Azimut Yachts Charter | Ava Yachting
description: Custom website design and SEO focused development for Azimut Yachts Charter by Ava Yachting. Built to rank for luxury yacht charter Croatia and drive high end charter inquiries.
overview:
Project Summary
We wrote, designed, and developed a luxury yacht charter website for Ava Yachting, focused on positioning them as a premium provider of Azimut yacht experiences along the Croatian coast. The site was built with SEO at its core, targeting “Luxury Yacht Charter Croatia” with a clear keyword structure, optimized headings, and strategic internal linking.

The design reflects elegance and exclusivity while maintaining clarity and ease of navigation. We structured the homepage to guide users through the experience, from destination inspiration to fleet exploration and booking. The result is a refined, search focused website that supports visibility, builds trust, and drives charter inquiries.

title: Bloc15 Web Design
overview:
We partnered with Bloc15, a premier event venue in the heart of Oakland, to elevate their online presence with a modern, polished, and conversion focused website. With more than 10,000 square feet of customizable event space, the new site was designed to highlight the venue’s versatility while making it easy for visitors to explore layouts, view amenities, and inquire about bookings.

Our goal was to create a digital experience that reflects the sophistication of the venue while improving usability, clarity, and search visibility. The website showcases Bloc15’s capacity options, sample floor plans, event services, and gallery in a way that guides visitors toward key actions like viewing the venue or booking a tour.

What We Focused On

• Presenting Bloc15 as Oakland’s leading venue for corporate, private, and fundraising events
• Highlighting the venue’s scale, floor plans, and amenities through clean layouts and strong visuals
• Creating a simple user journey with clear navigation and prominent booking calls to action
• Ensuring the site is SEO friendly with proper structure, metadata, and content organization
• Structuring pages so the Bloc15 team can easily update content as new events or offerings evolve

The Outcome

The redesigned Bloc15 website positions the venue as a top choice for event planners and businesses by combining beautiful visuals, intuitive navigation, and a strong SEO foundation. Visitors can quickly imagine their event in the space, explore all offerings, and book a consultation with confidence.

title: Effy Blue
description: Custom website for Effy Blue, an ethical non-monogamy coach, with a warm design and clear paths to book a coaching call.
overview:
Open Relationship Coaching Website

Effy Blue is a leading coach in ethical non monogamy, open relationships, and polyamory. She needed a website that felt warm, welcoming, and professional while organizing a large amount of content for her audience.

The Approach

I designed the site with a playful and inviting feel to match Effy’s personality and coaching style. Soft colors, friendly shapes, and clear typography help visitors feel safe and supported as they explore sensitive topics. The content is structured around the main stages people experience on their non monogamy journey: curiosity, transitioning, and navigating challenges.

Key Features

  • A friendly homepage that introduces Effy and her coaching approach
  • Clear pathways to book the 20 minute mutual assessment call
  • Organized sections for coaching, resources, workshops, podcast episodes, and articles
  • Strong testimonials for trust and social proof
  • Simple, conversational content to support users wherever they are in their journey

The Result

The final website gives Effy a polished, approachable digital presence that reflects her expertise and creates an easy, supportive experience for visitors. It serves as both an educational hub and a clear entry point into her coaching services.

title: FLOCO Rubber Surfacing
overview:
Rubber Surfacing Website Design

FloCo Decking Systems is a family owned rubber surfacing company based in Southwest Florida. They needed a website that felt bright, beachy, and Florida friendly while clearly explaining their services and improving their search visibility for high intent local keywords.

The Approach

I designed the site around a warm coastal vibe with soft blues, sandy tones, and clean spacing that mirrors the Florida outdoor lifestyle. The design feels sunny, friendly, and easy to browse. At the same time, I built the structure with strong SEO in mind. Clear service pages, location based content, and keyword optimized headings help FloCo rank for searches like rubber pool deck resurfacing, slip resistant pool decks, and rubber surfacing in Southwest Florida.

Key Features

  • Beach inspired visuals that match the local climate and customer expectations
  • SEO optimized service pages for residential, commercial, marine, safety, and rubber mulch
  • Location pages targeting Southwest Florida cities and expanding regions
  • Strong calls to action encouraging quotes, calls, and text inquiries
  • A gallery showcasing real projects
  • A blog built for long term SEO growth covering maintenance, drainage, and surfacing education
  • Testimonials from Florida clients to reinforce trust and credibility

The Result

The final website positions FloCo as the go to rubber surfacing team in Florida. It feels fresh and beach ready, reflects their family owned brand, and gives them a strong SEO foundation to attract more local leads year round.

title: GBT Logistics & Packaging
overview:
GBT Logistics & Packaging Inc. partnered with me to transform their online presence as they scale their warehousing and 3PL operations across Brampton and the Greater Toronto Area. With over 20 years in transportation and a growing SQF-certified warehouse, they needed a website that clearly communicates their services, builds trust with mid to upper-management supply chain professionals, and helps them stand out in a competitive market.

The new website was designed and built on WordPress using Astra and Elementor for speed, flexibility, and easy updates. The project included new SEO-optimized content for their core services — warehousing, transportation, co-packing, and 3PL — along with dedicated sections for industries served, sustainability efforts, and their company story.

A stronger visual identity was established using their navy and yellow brand palette, supported by clean layouts, industry-focused imagery, and clear calls to action. To support conversions and reduce bounce rate, the site features streamlined navigation and an interactive quote calculator to help potential clients estimate logistics costs quickly and easily.

The final result is a professional, modern website that reflects GBT Logistics’ growth, builds credibility, and positions them as a reliable, scalable partner for businesses across Canada and North America.

title: Kenaston Development
categoriesLine: Full Custom | Indigenous Design | Indigenous | Real Estate & Development
overview:
We partnered with Kenaston Development, one of Manitoba’s leading residential, commercial, and industrial developers, to redesign their website into a more modern, organized, and visually engaging platform. Their work spans entire communities, large scale developments, and partnerships with well known home builders, so the goal was to create a site that showcases that breadth while making it easy for visitors to explore current and upcoming projects.

The new website highlights Kenaston’s commitment to building thriving communities, features detailed project listings, and presents their services in a clear and approachable way. We also emphasized strong visuals and structured layouts to help homeowners, investors, and partners quickly understand what Kenaston offers.

What We Focused On

• Creating a clean, modern website that reflects Kenaston’s professionalism and community driven values
• Showcasing residential, commercial, and industrial projects with clear categories and easy navigation
• Presenting featured developments, such as Mountain Ridge Park and West Ridge Lakes, through strong visuals and consistent layouts
• Highlighting partnerships with local builders and Kenaston’s membership with the Manitoba Home Builders’ Association
• Ensuring the site is SEO friendly with proper structure, optimized content, and a clear information flow
• Building a backend that allows the Kenaston team to update projects and content with ease

The Outcome

The redesigned website positions Kenaston Development as a trusted and forward thinking developer in Manitoba. The site now acts as a polished showcase of their work, supports long term growth, and provides a smooth experience for anyone looking to learn about their services or explore new communities.

title: Khoury Mortgages
description: Leanne Digital DesignSolutions helped Paul transition from residential to commercial real estate with a full brand refresh, including a new logo and a professional one-page website delivered in just one week. Built for trust, credibility, and future scalability into a full site.
overview:
Paul approached Leanne Digital DesignSolutions when he was ready to reposition his business from residential to commercial real estate. He needed a brand identity that reflected this new direction — modern, credible, and built for growth.

Our team delivered a complete rebrand, starting with a fresh, professional logo that better represents his focus in the commercial sector. We then designed and developed a clean, high-impact one-page website built to establish trust with potential clients and showcase his services clearly.

The entire project was completed within one week, meeting the client’s timeline requirements without compromising quality. As Paul’s business continues to grow, we’ve planned a potential Phase Two to expand the one-page layout into a full, multi-page website with deeper content and advanced functionality.

Leanne Digital DesignSolutions specializes in fast, effective digital transformations like this — helping businesses elevate their brand, sharpen their positioning, and launch with confidence.

title: Krane Electrical + Mechanical Website
description: One-page website for Krane Electrical + Mechanical, built to showcase electrical and mechanical services and position the company as a trusted trades expert.
overview:
Krane Electrical + Mechanical is seeking a clean, modern one page website with an integrated blog section to showcase completed projects and highlight the company’s expertise. The goal is to create a strong online presence that positions Krane as a trusted expert across both electrical and mechanical services.

The website will feature clear sections outlining their full range of offerings, including sewer and water piping installation, septic field design, hydronic boiler systems, natural gas and propane installs, HVAC, air quality systems, equipment rentals, fire alarm installs, data networks, emergency power systems, electrical motor work, commissioning services, and full design-build electrical distribution.

Since Krane serves a wide range of customers — commercial clients, government and institutional buyers, industrial utility providers, and residential homeowners through their Enercare partnership — the site will be structured to speak to each audience with clarity and professionalism.

A dedicated blog area will allow Krane to share project highlights, build credibility, and support long term search visibility. The overall brand personality will lean into reliability, trust, and expertise, supported by branding that was designed earlier.

This one page build will give Krane Electrical + Mechanical a strong, credible foundation online and a simple place for potential clients to learn who they are, what they do, and why they are the right fit for future projects.

title: Krane Electrical + Mechanical Branding
description: Brand identity and logo design for Krane Electrical + Mechanical, plus a one-page WordPress site with an industrial look that builds trust and drives inquiries.
categoriesLine: One Page | Branding | Logo Design | Trades
overview:
Project Overview
Krane Electrical + Mechanical needed a strong brand foundation and a clear online presence to showcase their electrical and mechanical services. The goal was to create a professional, trustworthy identity and a one page website that clearly communicates what they do, builds credibility, and makes it easy for potential clients to get in touch.

Brand Direction
The branding was designed to feel bold, structured, and reliable. Clean typography, strong iconography, and an industrial inspired color palette were used to reflect Krane’s technical expertise and hands on approach.

Website Approach
The one page website was intentionally structured for clarity and usability. Services are clearly outlined, trust building elements are placed strategically, and the layout guides users naturally toward contact and conversion. The site is responsive, fast loading, and easy to maintain.

Deliverables

  • Logo design and brand identity

  • Logo variations and brand assets

  • Brand color palette and typography

  • One page WordPress website

  • Mobile responsive design

  • Conversion focused layout

Outcome
Krane Electrical + Mechanical now has a cohesive brand and a polished website that presents them as professional, capable, and reliable. The new identity and website provide a strong foundation for future growth.

title: Ma Mawi Wi Chi Itata Centre Gala
description: Custom digital gala program website and event materials for Ma Mawi Wi Chi Itata Centre’s 40 year celebration, including QR integration and a searchable seating feature for guests.
overview:
Project Summary
Ma Mawi Wi Chi Itata Centre hosted a special gala to celebrate over 40 years of working alongside Indigenous children, youth, and families. The evening honoured the staff, partners, supporters, and community members who have helped carry this work forward. Our role was to create a cohesive digital and in person experience that reflected the significance of that milestone and supported a smooth, engaging event night.

Website

We designed and developed a custom digital gala program website as part of our Indigenous web design work, replacing the traditional printed booklet with a modern, accessible experience. Built for mobile use during the event, the site included a unique search feature that allowed guests to quickly find their table assignments and seating details. The layout was structured for easy navigation, clear sponsor recognition, and real time access throughout the evening.

title: Mike Poirier Transport & Logistics
overview:
Mike’s Transport needed a simple yet professional online presence to showcase their services and make it easy for customers to get in touch. I designed and developed a clean, mobile-friendly one-page website that highlights their core offerings, service area, and contact details.

The site was built with scalability in mind, allowing for future SEO work and additional pages if needed. I also provided personalized training on how to make updates, and included 30 days of post-launch support for minor changes and testimonial updates.

To support long-term success, I offered guidance on setting up a Google Business Profile and explained ongoing options for security, maintenance, and lead generation through SEO and content growth.

This project was all about creating a strong first impression, building trust, and giving Mike’s Transport the tools they need to grow online.

title: Mr. Pool Guy
seoTitle: Mr. Pool Guy Miami Pool Service Website
description: Custom website for Mr. Pool Guy in Miami, designed to look tropical, build trust, and help homeowners find pool cleaning and repair services.
overview:
This project is focused on creating a clean, professional website for Mr. Pool Guy that reflects the bright, tropical feel of Miami while building trust with customers who need fast, reliable service. The goal is to design a site that not only looks great, but also supports long term visibility with a solid SEO-friendly structure.

The design will take a strategic, customer-first approach. Visitors should immediately understand who you are, what you offer, and how to contact you. The site will use a fresh color palette, simple layouts, and friendly, clear copy that reassures homeowners who might be stressed or dealing with pool issues. Every design choice will help position Mr. Pool Guy as reliable, approachable, and easy to work with.

The website will be organized so customers can quickly find the services they need, whether it’s cleaning, repairs, hot tub support, or regular maintenance. The final result will be a strong, easy-to-use online presence that helps you attract more customers and grow your business.

title: Oatley Vigmond
overview:
We partnered with Oatley Vigmond, one of Ontario’s leading personal injury law firms, to redesign and rebuild their website into a modern, accessible, and user friendly platform. The project included the creation of approximately 60 pages, all built with consistent templates to reflect strong brand standards and support a clear content hierarchy.

Our focus was on improving navigation, readability, and calls to action so visitors can easily learn about the firm, explore legal resources, and reach the intake team. We also structured the backend for long term ease of use, providing training and documentation after launch.

Key Objectives

• Create a polished, accessible website that reflects the firm’s reputation
• Build a consistent page system that supports usability and clarity
• Improve navigation and calls to action for better engagement
• Set up the backend for easy content management
• Implement essential SEO and accessibility best practices

Additional Support

The project also included key integrations that helped streamline content publishing and lead intake across the firm’s systems.

title: Oséko:wa
description: Bilingual website for Oséko:wa, an Indigenous-owned furniture supplier, built for government procurement and a professional first impression.
overview:
Oséko:wa is preparing to take an important step into the government procurement space, and this website will be the foundation that supports that growth. The goal is to create a clean, bilingual platform that reflects the company’s professionalism while honoring the story behind it — an Indigenous woman building a trusted and reliable furniture supply business in the Capital Region and across Eastern Ontario.

The website will present Oséko:wa’s services with clarity and confidence, provide space for all required procurement documents, and communicate the credibility needed for government buyers. Every part of the build will be designed with ease of use, transparency, and compliance in mind so Oséko:wa can confidently participate in procurement opportunities and make a strong first impression with agencies and partners.

title: Power Vac of Ottawa
overview:
Power Vac of Ottawa, a trusted duct cleaning company serving the region since 1965, approached us for a much-needed refresh of their outdated one-page website. Their old design relied heavily on dark greys and reds, which made the content feel compressed and didn’t reflect the professionalism or longevity of their brand. Our mission was simple: transform the site into a bright, modern, conversion-focused experience that showcases their services clearly and builds trust from the moment a visitor arrives.

We rebuilt the page from the ground up with a clean, airy layout, a refreshed colour palette, and clear visual hierarchy. Each core service—residential and commercial duct cleaning, dryer vent cleaning, and duct sealing/balancing—is now presented with strong visuals and concise messaging to help users quickly understand their options. Testimonials, trust markers, and call-to-action sections were strategically placed to reinforce credibility and encourage quote requests.

The end result is a modern, high-performing one-page site that aligns with Power Vac’s reputation as Ottawa’s long-standing air-quality experts—and is designed to convert more visitors into customers.

title: S+D Accounting
overview:
S+D Accounting Cloud Accounting Website Design

S+D Accounting is a tech-forward accounting firm serving small businesses across Ontario. They needed a modern, trustworthy website that communicates clarity, support, and ease. The design direction uses neutral tans with rich green accents to create a grounded, professional feel that reflects stability and growth.

The Approach

I designed the site to feel calm, clean, and confidence-building. The neutral palette softens what is often an overwhelming topic for business owners, while the deep greens give the brand a sense of reliability and expertise. The layout focuses on simple messaging, strong hierarchy, and clear pathways for users looking for bookkeeping, payroll, and tax support.

SEO was a major priority. Each section and service page is structured with optimized headings, keyword clarity, and scannable content tailored for Ontario small business searches such as outsourced bookkeeping, cloud accounting, and payroll services.

Key Features

  • A warm, minimalist design using tans and rich greens for professionalism and approachability
  • A strong hero section that clearly communicates the value of a dedicated finance team
  • A simple explanation of workflows and benefits to reduce overwhelm
  • Clear service pathways for bookkeeping, payroll, and tax support
  • Integrations highlighted for QuickBooks, Dext, Wagepoint, and Plooto
  • Social proof from Ontario professionals and long term clients
  • A focused call to action encouraging business owners to book a conversation

The Result

The finished website gives S+D Accounting a polished and modern online presence rooted in clarity and trust. It communicates their tech-forward approach, makes their services easy to understand, and strengthens their visibility for Ontario based small businesses searching for outsourced financial support.

title: Sierra Electrical
overview:
We began this project with a clear goal: to strengthen the client’s online presence by reshaping the first impression their website makes. Right now, their existing site does not guide visitors effectively, which lowers the chances of converting traffic into calls or quote requests. Our work in Phase One is focused on creating a modern, high impact redesign that improves clarity, trust, and overall conversions.

This phase centers on rebuilding the homepage and creating a dedicated Google Ads landing page. These two touchpoints have the greatest influence on both organic visitors and paid traffic, so improving them early on will set the foundation for stronger performance across the entire digital strategy.

What We Aim to Achieve

• Develop a clean, trustworthy homepage that communicates who they are and what they do within seconds
• Create a focused Google Ads landing page designed to improve paid traffic conversions
• Strengthen messaging for both residential and commercial audiences
• Provide a clearer path for visitors to call, request a quote, or learn more
• Establish a strong base before moving into SEO and future phases

The Goal

By completing this first phase, we aim to give the client faster, early improvements while keeping the process affordable and strategic. This phase will set the tone for better user experience, stronger ad performance, and a more effective website overall as we continue building toward long term growth.

title: Sisters Of The Holy Rock
overview:
Sisters of the Holy Rock

Entertainment and Fundraising Website Design

The Sisters of the Holy Rock are a long running volunteer performance group known for joyful shows, community spirit, and major fundraising impact. They needed a fresh website that felt bright, fun, and welcoming while still being easy to navigate for an older audience.

The Approach

I created a design using bold purples, playful accents, and large, easy to read typography. The goal was to keep the experience lively without overwhelming users. Increasing font sizes, improving spacing, and simplifying layout choices made the site accessible and comfortable to use, especially for visitors who might not be tech savvy.

At the same time, the design respects the group’s history. The tone stays warm, friendly, and community focused, reflecting the spirit of their performances and the heart behind their fundraising work.

Key Features

  • A bright playful look built around purple tones
  • Large, legible typography for accessibility without feeling childish
  • Clear pathways to see upcoming events, book a fundraiser, or join the group
  • A gallery showcasing the joy and energy of past performances
  • A testimonials section highlighting audience experiences
  • Easy to maintain event listings and review submissions

The Result

The final website captures the fun, musical, and heartfelt personality of the Sisters while making it simple for visitors to find events, book shows, or learn more about joining. It supports the group’s mission to bring joy and raise funds for local causes and offers an inviting experience for audiences of all ages.

title: Spotted Eagle Handmade
overview:
Spotted Eagle Handmade is a luxury Indigenous brand created by an Anishinaabe Ikwe artist who blends cultural artistry with high-quality craftsmanship. The project focused on creating a brand identity and logo that reflect her artistry, heritage, and commitment to premium handmade goods.

Spotted Eagle Handmade offers hand-knit pieces made from 100 percent merino wool along with beautifully crafted beaded earrings. Every item is created with intention, care, and cultural knowledge, then shipped with tracking and insurance to ensure a reliable customer experience.

Brand Direction

The goal was to design a logo that feels elegant, meaningful, and rooted in culture. The feather illustration represents knowledge, strength, and connection to spirit, while the gold accents add a modern, elevated touch that matches the luxury nature of her products.

Design Solution

The final logo combines a detailed illustrated feather with a clean serif wordmark to create a brand identity that is both expressive and refined. The gold typography and accents symbolize warmth and high-end craftsmanship, supporting her vision of offering luxury handmade goods with cultural integrity.

Outcome

The result is a visual identity that celebrates her Anishinaabe roots and positions Spotted Eagle Handmade as a premium Indigenous brand. The design balances tradition and modern sophistication, giving her a strong foundation for packaging, online presence, and future product lines.

title: Swan Planning Consultancy
overview:
Swan Planning Consultancy is a woman-owned planning firm founded by Heather Swan, a seasoned Plangineer (Planner + Engineer) with over 25 years of experience working alongside Indigenous communities, government bodies, and corporate clients across Canada. With a focus on reconciliation, Indigenous inclusion, and relationship-driven collaboration, the brand needed a visual identity that felt grounded, graceful, and meaningful.

Scope of Work

  • Primary Logo
    A thoughtful, elegant mark featuring a stylized swan, subtly inspired by Indigenous design elements and reflective of land and water themes.

  • Secondary Logo
    A horizontal variation ideal for documents, headers, and web applications.

  • Submark
    A compact icon-style logo designed for social media, profile images, and branded collateral.

  • One-Page Brand Style Sheet
    A clean, easy-to-follow brand reference covering logo usage, color palette (earthy and calming tones), and typography selections that convey professionalism with warmth.

Design Approach
The logo suite was built to echo Swan Planning’s core values: Respect, Relationship, Reciprocity, Responsibility, and Reconciliation. The swan—symbolic of transformation and harmony—was paired with gentle curves and nature-inspired lines to represent balance, water, and grounded movement. The resulting identity is approachable yet authoritative, modern yet timeless.

This identity now supports Swan Planning’s mission to advance inclusive, values-driven planning in partnership with Indigenous communities and institutions across Canada.

title: That Date Was Great!
overview:
We’re currently working with the client to build a luxury brand identity and a streamlined one page website that reflects their warm, pressure free approach to modern matchmaking. This project is focused on creating a visual and emotional experience that feels high quality, romantic, and genuinely human, setting them apart from the typical dating app world.

As we develop the logo suite, we’re blending elegance with soft romantic details to create a versatile identity that works across all platforms. The website will extend this feeling through storytelling, subtle emotional cues, and a layout that helps visitors understand the service and feel comfortable taking the next step.

What We’re Working Toward

• A luxury aesthetic that builds trust and communicates quality
• Romantic touches that express warmth, connection, and ease
• Messaging that gently addresses pain points and positions this as a better alternative to dating apps
• A conversion focused layout that guides visitors naturally from curiosity to reaching out
• A simple, scalable WordPress build that can easily grow into a multi page website

The Goal

By the end of this project, the client will have a polished, high end brand presence supported by a clear, emotionally resonant website. This foundation will help them attract the right audience, communicate their unique approach, and create a strong digital starting point for future growth.

title: Ti-Yende Moving
overview:
Ti-Yende Movers is a proud Winnipeg-based, father-and-son moving company with over 13 years of trusted service in their community. They approached us looking for a full website redesign that better reflected their professionalism, reliability, and family-driven values.

Our team delivered a modern, conversion-focused website built to boost local visibility and increase quote requests. The new design features a bold hero section, clear service pathways, and strong calls to action—all wrapped in a clean, trustworthy aesthetic tailored to the moving industry.

The result is a mobile-optimized, user-friendly site that showcases Ti-Yende’s experience, reputation, and commitment to “making a difference with every move.”

title: We Film Events
overview: This project is a full redesign and rebuild of the We Film Events website, focused on improving performance, clarity, and ease of use. The goal is to create a faster, more modern WordPress site that better reflects current services, is easy to edit internally, and provides stronger SEO foundations for long-term growth. The rebuild prioritizes clean structure, optimized video handling, clear service flows, and a smoother path for clients to request quotes and get in touch.
